# `Q-3-38` — JSON Serialization Failed

> The AST-to-JSON serialization process failed.

## What this means

Quarto's JSON writer turns the document AST into the JSON form
that downstream tools (filters, Pandoc, the hub-client renderer)
consume. This error fires when the serialization step itself
fails — the document was parsed and processed, but converting
the in-memory AST to a JSON string did not succeed.

## Why this happens

The most common underlying cause is a `serde_json` failure:
typically a non-finite floating-point number (`NaN`, `±∞`) in
the AST, since JSON does not represent those values. Any node
field that holds a number can in principle trigger this if it
was filled in with a non-finite value.

## How to fix

If the document does not visibly contain numeric content that
could be non-finite, suspect a Lua filter or other processing
step that introduced one. Render to a non-JSON format
(`--to native` or `--to qmd`) to confirm the issue is in
serialization, not in the pipeline.

If no custom processing is in use, report the document at the
Quarto issue tracker — Quarto should not produce non-finite
numbers itself.
